channel.title: JLT Monday Mindset (LinkedIn Business)
channel.description: Monday Mindset — universal lessons from Janine's founder stories, LinkedIn Business edition

item.title: Most of leadership doesn't happen at the extremes. It lives in the narrow gap between being too soft and being too sharp. We tend to picture leaders as one fixed setting, firm and decisive, and assume warmth is the weaker option. It isn't. Kind and firm aren't opposites on a dial. The clearest, most honest feedback is often the kindest thing we can offer. The calibration is daily, and we'll get it slightly wrong often. That's not a flaw in the work. That is the work.
